description: A siren's blast: a wail rising from low to pitch as the rotor spins up over rise, held, and falling back over fall at its end (the siren 'can emit a wailing sound', IHO S-12). Its tone is a rotor chopping air: odd harmonics strong, as a square wave's. No source gives its pitch: a starting value. harmonics are the partials' levels. A point source: its level falls 6 dB each time the distance doubles from near metres. Frequencies in Hz, times in seconds, levels as gains.
